# FPGA_SNN_Inference

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deployment of spiking neural network inference workloads onto field-programmable gate arrays using the hls4ml high-level synthesis toolchain. Enables low-latency, energy-efficient neuromorphic inference on reconfigurable hardware, bridging algorithmic SNN models with practical edge deployment.
